description:
Althea Aurora is a student innovation team driven by curiosity, technology, and purpose. Inspired by Althea, a symbol of hope and healing, and Aurora, a symbol of new beginnings and limitless possibilities, our mission is to build intelligent solutions that create meaningful real world impact

We believe innovation should not only solve problems but also improve lives. By combining Artificial Intelligence, and modern technologies, we strive to design solutions that are reliable, and future ready
